title: Bolus requested through WearOS is not executed
body:
After confirming the desired bolus on WearOS, I get a toast indicating 'treatment requested', but the treatment is never executed while I am close to my phone. I am using the Omnipod Dash, Galaxy Watch 4 and the S22 and run the most recent operating systems and the most recent versions of AndroidAPS for both my phone and watch.

I was trying to explore this issue, but I am too illiterate in Kotlin to make sense of this. Yet, my idea is that it is going wrong at line 76 where EventWearToMobile is called: [link](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/f8acbad759ccdc4dcdc58a7d150103dfe757ff94/wear/src/main/java/info/nightscout/androidaps/interaction/actions/TreatmentActivity.kt)

comments.body:

Do your receive the confirmation message?

Does this mean 'allowed within certain predefined boundaries' such as maximum bolus size, or does allowance involve an additional manual step?

I do not receive a confirmation message on the watch nor see anything happening in the app on my phone.

It is working now. The only thing that I can think of that has changed is that I passed objective 3. Are these objectives in any way linked to the ability of the user to administer boluses through WearOS?
